h: VDM says God did not call Tonto Dikeh after her preaching video goes viral
p: VeryDarkMan has questioned Tonto Dikeh's calling as an evangelist after a video of her preaching about faith and wealth went viral. His comments sparked mixed reactions.
body: Social media critic VeryDarkMan (VDM) has questioned actress-turned-evangelist Tonto Dikeh's calling after a video of her preaching in church spread online.

The clip, shared on Instagram on 18 November 2026, showed Tonto Dikeh delivering a sermon on faith and wealth. She urged believers to see money as a blessing from God but warned against making it an idol, stressing that riches should be used for good rather than personal glory.
VDM reacted by disputing the idea that Tonto had received a divine call to preach, saying in effect that God did not call her.
more: Tonto preached about faith and money.
